entries.zh: 淳：淳厚质朴，诚实不浇薄；（西语 templança）节制、温厚之德
entries.en: temperance, moderation; honest simplicity, purity of character

entries.zh: 淳朴：质朴敦厚，不加文饰；残句疑谓行事有度、朴实无华
entries.en: simple, honest and unpretentious; (damaged Spanish lemma, apparently 'to keep due measure')
entries.notes: 西语词头两处残缺存疑（medi…、by…），且 M 栏次音节声调 T99 污损；释义依 H 淳朴、M tūn poc。

entries.zh: 俭用：节省用度，花销有节制
entries.en: frugal in expenditure; temperate in spending

entries.zh: 俭使：省用惜费，用钱用物皆有节制
entries.en: to spend and use sparingly; economical

entries.zh: 俭口：节制口腹、省吃；亦谓口上有节、不多言
entries.en: temperate of mouth; moderate in eating, sparing of speech

entries.zh: 调：调音定弦（如比维拉琴类乐器）；调和
entries.en: to tune (an instrument) as on a vihuela/guitar; to attune, harmonize

entries.zh: 和：调和相应；应和、随声相和；和洽
entries.en: to harmonize; to join in song or respond in accord; concord

entries.zh: 和调：声律谐调，彼此调和相应
entries.en: harmonious attunement; to tune in concord

entries.zh: 庵：小庙、佛庵（尼寺或静修小院）
entries.en: temple: small Buddhist shrine, nunnery or hermitage
temple; shrine for gods or ancestors

entries.zh: 寺：佛寺，僧众住持修行之寺院
entries.notes: M 栏寺字仅存残形、声调 T99 污损；释义依 H 寺、L Templo。

entries.zh: 祠：祠堂，奉祀祖先或先贤之庙
entries.en: ancestral shrine; hall of worship for ancestors or worthies

entries.zh: 院：寺院、庙院（殿庭院落式的庙宇）
entries.notes: M 栏院字仅存残笔、构拟为空且声调 T99；释义依 H 院、L Templo。

entries.zh: 庵庙：庵堂庙宇，泛指寺庙
entries.en: temples and shrines in general; religious houses

entries.zh: 庵寺：庵堂与佛寺，泛指佛门庙宇
entries.en: Buddhist temples and convents; religious houses
entries.notes: M 栏寺字声调 T99 污损；释义依 H 庵寺与 L Templo。

entries.zh: 神庙：供奉神明之庙宇（华人民间神祠）
entries.en: temple of the gods; idol temple (Chinese popular cult)

entries.zh: 宫观：帝王宫苑中的庙观；道观
entries.en: temple of a royal palace; palace shrine; Daoist temple
entries.notes: L 尾词 deliao/deliado 存疑、M 栏观字声调 T99；释义依 H 宫观、M quiong cua。

entries.zh: 生祠：为在世之人（有德之恩人）预先立庙奉祀之祠
entries.en: shrine erected to a living benefactor ('temple of the one who did good')

entries.zh: 祠堂：宗祠家庙，祭祀祖先的厅堂
entries.notes: M 栏堂字声调 T99 污损；释义依 H 祠堂与 L Templo del bien hecho。
